bootstrap.method: paired percentile cluster bootstrap over the 20 starts

candidate_informativeness.explanation: 0/20 starts meet the fixed >=5 meaningful groups and >0.1 mm range rule; 15/20 were required

candidate_rollout_transfer.explanation: adaptive start-cluster mean terminal MSE is lower than matched in both spaces under the sealed directional rule, but both descriptive 95% intervals cross zero

downstream_planning_evidence.explanation: goal-cost alignment and candidate informativeness remain unsupported, and adaptive changes no informative-start selection; the nominal prior ranking label does not justify planning or control

diagnostic_summary.interpretation: the model ranks its own latent goal-cost target substantially better than that target ranks physical outcomes, but zero starts meet the fixed informativeness rule, so the consumed pool cannot isolate representation failure cleanly
diagnostic_summary.rollout_transfer: adaptive has a tiny directional mean-MSE edge over matched in both spaces, with both descriptive 95% intervals crossing zero

goal_cost_alignment.interpretation: actual-terminal ceiling removes rollout prediction error and isolates frozen goal-cost representation alignment

reporting_clarification.reason: when zero starts met the sealed informativeness rule, report all rank-defined subthreshold diagnostics explicitly rather than displaying null informative-only summaries

strongest_caveats: The 20-start pilot is already consumed; all intervals are descriptive.
